title: Two-signature bundle slot (serverless maker-checker — HELM-MAKERCHECKER-BUILD-SPEC.md)
description: A maker's evidence bundle plus zero or more independent checker countersignatures, each over the SAME bundle_digest the maker signed. FU-5 (HELM-MAKERCHECKER-BUILD-SPEC.md §6): the maker_signature producer now exists (HELM-MAKERCHECKER-BUILD-1) — this is no longer a reserved, unwired shape. `maker_signature` alone (no countersignatures) remains a complete, valid bundle per §26.7; a `threshold` is only meaningful once at least one countersignature is expected.

attesterKind.description: HELM-MAKERCHECKER-BUILD-SPEC.md MC-2.1: whether the signing key is held by a natural person (human) or by software with no person in the loop at signing time (automated, e.g. helmd's own daemon-held key per MC-2.4). Recorded at signing time by the producer — never inferred by a reader.

makerSignature.description: MC-1.2/MC-2.1: the maker's signature over bundle_digest, from an explicit signing act, carrying its own attester_kind (never inferred from run ownership or the daemon's identity).

identity.description: OCG SPEC.md §27.1/§27.3 identity shape — the checker's did:key or LEI. Distinct-identity threshold counting (below) counts THIS id, never the signing key, so one checker rotating keys or signing twice counts once.

replay_verified.description: True iff the checker independently re-ran the workflow deterministically and got a matching bundle_digest before countersigning — the flagship differentiator over a rubber-stamp approval. Omitted (not false) for a Tier-B binding-integrity checker, which never re-runs a kernel — see HELM-HA-BUILD-SPEC.md §3.3.

attester_kind.description: MC-2.2: only a countersignature of kind human counts toward `threshold`. MC-2.3: an automated attestation MUST NOT, by itself, satisfy a threshold.

maker_signature.description: null until the maker's explicit signing act (MC-1.2) establishes it — MC-1.1: a slot with no maker_signature refuses every countersignature, it does not silently admit one.

countersignatures.description: Independent checker countersignatures over the same bundle_digest. MC-7: additive only — a countersignature is never removed or rewritten, even one a later rule would refuse to count.

threshold.description: E-6: OPTIONAL until satisfaction is determined, then PINNED — the count of DISTINCT `human`-kind checker identity.id values (MC-1.3, MC-2.2) that were required at `as_of`. Mirrors OCG SPEC.md §27.3's in-toto integer threshold. A threshold read from live policy at examination time answers a different question than the one the examiner asked, so once pinned it is not moved.

as_of.description: E-7: when the satisfaction determination recorded by `threshold` was made. A slot is a claim about a moment; without this, "satisfied" is undated and silently becomes a claim about now.
